summary.sampling_scope: Before process spawn through process termination, including model load, all prefill/capture/decode and gaps; observed samples, not a mathematical continuous peak.
summary.limits: Four fresh processes in baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline order, same GPU/12 mixed authored requests/cap64/EOS/weights,638 exact token comparisons each. External NVMLv2 every target100ms includes loading and all request phases; actual sample gaps reported. NVML used excludes driver-reserved memory. Samples can miss faster transients, so maximum observed is not an exact continuous peak. Fixed ABBA order is not randomized. No new quality or concurrent service claim.
